title: Persisted Inventory Evidence Reads
selectedSlice: C — both independent persisted evidence read APIs
purpose: Provide independent deterministic read-only enumeration of durable production-batch evidence by exact SKU and durable physical-inventory movement evidence by exact batch.

productionBatchRead.ordering: batch id binary ascending, then batch version ascending

rules: Both APIs are read-only and authority-free.
Caller selector and pagination inputs are strictly validated before database access.
Every returned durable row is reconstructed through the canonical FOOD domain validator.
Returned production batches must bind the requested exact SKU id/version.
Returned movements must bind the requested exact batch id/version.
Durable malformed, uncertain, duplicated, out-of-order or selector-divergent state fails closed as storage-failure.
Pagination uses limit plus one lookahead.
Only returned page items are fully reconstructed; lookahead identity establishes continuation.
Returned items, cursors and page results are detached and frozen.
Production-batch pagination does not infer latest versions.
Movement pagination does not order or filter by occurredOn.
These reads do not compose evidence into recorded balances.
These reads do not prove that pagination observes a complete consistent point-in-time snapshot under concurrent appends.
No evidence completeness or cutoff provenance is claimed.
No current quantity-on-hand authority is created.
No reservation-aware availability is created.
No stocked SKU capacity is created or written.
No authentication or trusted mutation authority is introduced.
No SQL INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE occurs.
No migration change is required.
Migration 0003 remains unchanged and unexecuted.
Migration 0004 remains unchanged and unexecuted.
deferred: Consistent evidence cutoff or snapshot provenance.
Composition of persisted batch and movement reads into recorded balances.
Stocked SKU capacity derivation and writing.
Performance indexes for exact-SKU batch and exact-batch movement enumeration.
